title: One chip against the planet: which is bigger?
subtitle: One computer chip against everyone on Earth, then against all the chickens eaten in a year: pick the bigger, and hear two hosts argue about it.
shape: 5 + 6 (duel chain, two voices; b the skeptic)
notes: Reworked after review (was WEAK): a duel instead of a guess-the-number. OWID: 2,308 transistors (1971) and 58.2 billion (2021, latest; brief said 100+ billion); people on Earth 7.95 billion (2021, OWID/UN WPP); chickens slaughtered for meat 78.5 billion (2024, OWID/FAO). Seven per person and ×25 million are my arithmetic. Chip-pace (Moore) twist dropped, kept only in genome-cost. Compare cards: x is the left edge and width the span; a card in two pairs stands in its first row. stage own fades the chip (and the heading) while the duel is asked; the ask instruction replaces the heading during the ask (engine behaviour). No chip icon in twemoji, so the chip is drawn and the card icon is a desktop computer.
